• Ground floor: 140 m² of covered rentable space and stairs; a 1.50 m walkway fronting the rentable space and ending at the stair; a 2.70 × 3.45 m stair at the left front corner; 2.0 × 2.0 m open yards at both rear corners for ventilation; a front yard exactly 14.80 m wide × 10.50 m deep for long- and short-term parking.
• Second floor: 191.80 m², extending 3.5 m toward the street over the ground floor; a 1.50 × 11.65 m front balcony, rentable spaces, toilets, a generator room; stair and hallway 3.15 m wide (20.32 m²).
• 3rd and 4th floors: 221.40 m² each with open rear corners; the 3rd floor for rent, the 4th for the owners' firm; stair and hallway extend 2.0 m further toward the street (26.62 m²); a 2.0 m balcony up to the firewall.
• Roof deck: 26.62 m² stairwell with storage; firewalls on two sides; minimum front and rear setbacks apply.

Site: A rectangular inside lot in Cebu City, 14.80 m wide × 20.50 m deep. Lots on the east, north and west; the RROW and sidewalk on the south (short side). The highest grade is 200 mm above the sidewalk; the ROW is 12.0 m.

n: The 5.00 m front setback strip: 14.80 × 5.00 = 74.00 m²; 74.00 + 29.60 = 103.60 m² TOSL.
